column1: # evelyn_pairs.tsv -- printed cipher numbers beside their printed decipherments (Nicholas's interlinear decipherments as set in type),
# Bray (ed.), Memoirs illustrative of the life and writings of John Evelyn, 2nd ed. 1819, vol. II, "Correspondence between K. Charles I.
# and Sir Edward Nicholas", pp.102-113 -- the pages the DECODE 9119 form (Add MS 32256 ff.8-9, "From Evelyn's Memoirs", P.102/111/113) cites.
# Source: Internet Archive memoirsillustrat02eveluoft, leaves n469-n480 (page_numbers.json), read by eye on iiif_lines crops of the page images
# (R15-MREVL, 6 Oct 2026). Scope: only the codes the 7 July 1645 letter uses that key9119.tsv leaves blank and that print on pp.102-113, plus
# the 9119 rows those glosses test. Gloss words are set above the numbers and drift by up to one code, so 'conf' says how the word was tied
# to the code. Grade C = from the printed decipherment; M = the tie of word to code is uncertain; I = inferred from neighbouring form values.
# vs9119: agree / conflict / extends (code blank on the 9119 form).
# D1A-EVL (8 Oct 2026): full harvest of pp.82-120 by keys/evelyn_harvest.py -> evelyn_harvest_pairs.tsv (94 gloss/cipher line pairs) and
# tools/interlinear_align.py (PREREG-D1A-EVL.md). Only pp.102-115 passed the gates (shuffle real 17 vs p95 8; 14/17 agree with key9119);
# pp.92-101 failed both (real 6 vs p95 8; 0/3), p.120 and pp.82-91 too thin. Rows marked D1A-EVL below were read from the aligned pairs by eye.
